description:
#### **About Saleshandy**

Saleshandy is a cold email outreach platform used by thousands of sales teams, agencies and founders worldwide to book more meetings. Our stack spans outreach, B2B lead data, email infrastructure and deliverability, and organic search is one of our largest acquisition channels.

We compete in one of the most contested SERPs in SaaS: cold email, sales engagement and lead generation, against well-funded players like Apollo, Instantly and Lemlist. **We're hiring an SEO Team Lead to own that battle end to end**: set the strategy, do the hard work yourself, and build a team that compounds organic pipeline quarter after quarter.

#### **Role snapshot**

* **Title:** SEO Team Lead
* **Reports to:** VP, Marketing & Demand Generation
* **Team:** Lead the SEO team (Senior SEO Executive, SEO Executives), grow headcount as results compound
* **Split:** ~70% hands-on execution, ~30% strategy and people leadership
* **Scope:** Technical, on-page, content strategy, off-page/link building, AI search visibility (AI Overviews, LLMs)
* **Location:** Ahmedabad, India (on-site)
* **Experience:** 3-5 years in SEO, 2+ years in B2B SaaS, 1+ year leading a team
* **Type:** Full-time

#### **What you'll own**

You own organic search as a revenue channel, from the keyword universe to the signup.

**1. SEO strategy & roadmap**

* Build and own the quarterly SEO roadmap tied to signups, trials and MQLs, not vanity traffic
* Map the full keyword universe and topic clusters across BOFU (alternatives, comparisons, pricing, use cases), MOFU and TOFU
* Prioritise ruthlessly by impact × effort; report progress to marketing leadership monthly

**2. Technical SEO (hands-on)**

* Run and fix site audits: crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, canonicals, redirects, hreflang, schema, internal linking
* Work directly with developers on site architecture, templates and programmatic SEO pages
* Own Google Search Console, sitemaps, log-file analysis and migration safety

**3. On-page & content SEO**

* Write SEO briefs and optimise existing pages: product, feature, comparison, integration, blog and landing pages
* Run content refresh and pruning programs to recover decaying rankings
* Partner with content writers on search intent, E-E-A-T and conversion-focused page structure

**4. Off-page & authority building**

* Own the link-building strategy: digital PR, data-led assets, guest posts, partnerships, broken-link and unlinked-mention outreach
* Grow high-quality referring domains in our niche while keeping the backlink profile clean
* Use Saleshandy itself to run outreach at scale

**5. AI search visibility (GEO/AEO)**

* Grow Saleshandy's presence in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and other LLM answers
* Track brand mentions, citations and share of voice versus competitors; act on the gaps

**6. Team leadership**

* Lead, coach and grow the SEO team; set weekly goals, review work and raise the quality bar
* Hire as the channel scales; build SOPs and playbooks so execution doesn't depend on one person

**7. Analytics & reporting**

* Own SEO dashboards in GA4, GSC, Ahrefs and PostHog: rankings, traffic, conversions and assisted pipeline
* Turn data into the next sprint's priorities, not just a monthly report

#### **Your first 90 days**

By day 90 you'll have a funded roadmap, shipped quick wins and a team running on a weekly cadence.

**Days 1-30**

* **Focus:** Full technical, content and backlink audit; competitor gap analysis; meet the team and set working rhythm
* **Outcome:** Audit + prioritised backlog presented to leadership

**Days 31-60**

* **Focus:** Ship technical fixes and top-20 page optimisations; launch BOFU cluster and link-building engine
* **Outcome:** First ranking and CTR gains on money pages; link pipeline live

**Days 61-90**

* **Focus:** Scale content and programmatic pages; AI-visibility tracking; SOPs and team KPIs
* **Outcome:** Quarterly roadmap with targets; team owning clear goals

**How we'll measure success**

* Organic signups, trials and MQLs (primary)
* Non-brand organic traffic and top-3 rankings for commercial keywords
* Quality referring domains gained per month
* Share of voice in AI Overviews and LLM answers vs competitors
* Technical health score and Core Web Vitals pass rate
* Team output, quality and growth

#### **What you bring**

**Must-haves**

* 3-5 years of hands-on SEO, with 2+ years in B2B SaaS or a competitive tech niche
* 1+ year leading SEO people; you've coached executives into strong specialists
* Proven, quantified wins: you can show traffic, rankings and signup growth you personally drove
* Deep technical SEO: you can read a crawl, diagnose indexation issues and spec fixes for developers without hand-holding
* Strong on-page and content SEO: search intent, briefs, topic clusters, internal linking, CRO basics
* A link-building track record built on outreach, PR and assets, not paid link farms
* Current with AI search: Google AI Overviews, LLM citations and how they change SEO
* Data fluency across GA4, GSC and Ahrefs/Semrush; comfortable in Excel/Sheets and Looker Studio
* Clear written English and the ownership to run with ambiguity

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience in sales tech, martech or outreach/cold email SaaS
* Programmatic SEO at scale (hundreds to thousands of pages)
* Basic HTML/CSS/JS, WordPress or headless CMS, and Python or Screaming Frog custom extraction
* International SEO (US, UK, EU markets)
* Experience using AI tools to speed up research, briefs and audits

#### **Tools you'll use**

Ahrefs, Google Search Console, GA4, PostHog, Screaming Frog, Looker Studio, WordPress, Saleshandy (for outreach), and AI tools of your choice.

#### **Why you'll love it here**

* Full ownership of a channel that directly moves revenue, and leadership that backs you
* A real budget for tools, content and links
* A fast, founder-led team where good ideas ship in days, not quarters
* Room to grow into Head of SEO as the team scales

Technik Spirits MedTech Pvt. Ltd. designs and manufactures **medical gas plant room equipment** for hospitals: Medical Air Compressor Systems, Medical Vacuum Pump Systems, Medical Oxygen Generators and Anaesthetic Gas Scavenging Systems (AGSS).

Our systems are **patented** and our installations range from 12-bed NICUs to 2,400-bed medical colleges. Our customers are hospitals, hospital promoters, consultants, architects, MGPS contractors and dealers. We are a small, growing team.

Website: technikspirits.com

You will own our digital presence and run our marketing campaigns from start to finish. You will work directly with the founder/MD.

* **Lead generation (about 50%):** ads, LinkedIn, email and WhatsApp campaigns
* **Content and brand (about 50%):** design, blogs, social media, website and marketing material

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a data-driven Senior SEO Executive to lead our organic growth strategy from our Ahmedabad office. You’ll own search performance across traditional search engines and AI-powered platforms such as Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Copilot, and mentor a team of SEO executives. **What You’ll Do**

* Run website audits and optimize pages, blogs, and landing pages for target keywords and search intent
* Implement meta tags, schema markup, internal linking, and site structure improvements
* Build topical authority through pillar pages and topic clusters
* Work with writers to create helpful content aligned with E-E-A-T

* Structure content for AI extraction (FAQs, comparison tables, clear answers)

*Off-Page and Digital PR*

*Technical SEO*

* Fix crawling, indexing, and rendering issues with the dev team
* Manage sitemaps, canonicals, redirects, and hreflang for multi-region sites

*Analytics and Reporting*

* Manage GA4, Search Console, GTM, and Looker Studio dashboards
* Measure organic contribution to leads and pipeline with sales and CRM teams

*Team and Process*

* Lead, mentor, and train junior and mid-level SEO executives

* Experience with AI visibility tools (Semrush AI Toolkit, Ahrefs Brand Radar, Profound, or similar)
* Familiarity with WordPress, Shopify, Magento, or headless CMS
* Strong analytical, reporting, and communication skills, plus experience managing junior team members

title: Digital Marketing Specialist at Highadvocacy
description:
**About the role\- https://highadvocacy.com/**
----------------------------------------------

**HighAdvocacy** is hiring its first marketing person. Your job is to take our website from where it is today to 10,000\+ qualified monthly visitors in the next six months.


You'll get there through earned channels: blog posts that rank on Google, a real LinkedIn cadence on the company page and on the founder's personal one, Reddit and X threads where our buyers hang out, and one or two channels you'll find by testing a handful.


For the first 60 days, Piyush (our co\-founder) works alongside you. He'll review drafts, help you build a point of view, and give real feedback. After that, you start making the channel calls. By month six, you're the marketing brain of the company and Piyush is reviewing your decisions, not making them.


This is a full\-time, in\-office role in Ahmedabad. You report directly to Piyush. There's no agency next to you, no senior marketer above you, and no playbook on a shared drive. The brand voice on the internet six months from now will largely be the one you ship.

**What you'll actually be doing**
---------------------------------


Your weekly rhythm looks like this:

* Write 2\-4 blog posts a week for HighAdvocacy.com. Useful enough to rank on Google, honest enough to share.
* Run a 5x/week LinkedIn cadence on the company page. Collaborate with Piyush on posts from his personal profile.
* Find 15\-20 conversations a week on Reddit, X, and LinkedIn where our ICP is asking real questions. Reply like a human, not a brand account.
* Live inside Ahrefs, Google Search Console, and Plausible. Use them to debug what's working, not to confirm what you already believe.
* Test one new channel every month: a newsletter swap, a podcast appearance, a community partnership. Be honest about whether it's worth continuing.
* Ship a short dashboard every Friday. What went out, what moved, what you're trying next.
* Build a small library of templates, post formats, and frameworks the next hire can pick up.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------


We'll measure progress against these checkpoints together:

**First 30 days** \- 4 blog posts shipped, a LinkedIn cadence running 5x/week, and 15\+ thoughtful Reddit or X comments out in the wild.

**First 90 days** \- You've tested SEO, LinkedIn, Reddit, X, and one community channel. You bring a written recommendation on which 1\-2 channels deserve 70% of your time, defended in a Friday review.

**3 months** \- 5,000 qualified monthly visitors. At least one channel running on autopilot, without Piyush reviewing every piece of output.

**6 months** \- 10,000 qualified monthly visitors. Compounding output across two channels. You're making channel\-level decisions with light founder review.

**How we think about AI in this role**
--------------------------------------


We expect you to use AI every day. The difference we care about is using it as leverage versus using it as a crutch.


Here's how we actually use these tools:

**Claude or ChatGPT** \- Drafting blog outlines, ideating angles, rewriting weak sections, testing your thinking, summarizing competitor content.

**Perplexity** \- Fast research, finding sources and statistics, sanity\-checking claims before publishing.

**Ahrefs AI features** \- Keyword clustering, content gap analysis, surfacing backlink prospects.

**AI for repurposing** \- Turning one blog into a LinkedIn post, an X thread, and a Reddit reply, without making them sound like the same recycled paragraph.

**Pattern analysis** \- Pulling apart top\-performing posts in our space and figuring out what's actually working.

**Cursor or v0 (bonus)** \- Spinning up small landing page experiments without waiting on a designer.


What we don't want: AI\-generated final copy anyone can spot in three seconds. Your taste and voice ship the final draft. AI gets you to about 60% of the work, faster. The last 40%, the part that makes it sound human, is on you.

**Who we're hoping applies**
----------------------------


The best signal for this role isn't years of experience or a degree. It's whether you live on the internet and pay attention to how things land.


This role is probably right for you if a few of these are true:

* You've drafted a LinkedIn post or a tweet in your head while showering.
* You can name 5 people you follow on X and explain why for each.
* You read the comments under good LinkedIn posts to figure out why they worked.
* You'd rather ship 50 honest LinkedIn posts than 1 polished case study that took a month to approve.
* You think most B2B SaaS marketing reads like the same paragraph copy\-pasted across the internet, and you can point at examples.
* You've shipped something publicly on your own time: a blog, an X account, a side project, a newsletter. Audience size doesn't matter. The shipping does.
* You use AI to move faster through the boring parts, not to think for you.

**Who probably shouldn't apply**
--------------------------------


Skip this role if any of these feel true:

* You need a playbook handed to you before you can start.
* The first thing on your resume is "HubSpot Certified" or a marketing degree.
* You haven't shipped anything publicly outside a job you were paid for.
* You find Ahrefs intimidating and don't want to learn it.
* You're hoping someone else (an agency, a senior, the founder) does the work and you review it.

**What we're not asking for**
-----------------------------


None of these are required. Don't filter yourself out if you don't have them:

* Prior B2B SaaS experience. You'll pick up the context in two weeks.
* SEO certifications. Ahrefs and a few good blogs will teach you more in a month.
* Paid ads experience. Out of scope for this role.
* Video or design skills. Not what we need here.
* HubSpot, Marketo, or any specific automation tool. We don't use them.
* An MBA or a marketing degree. Irrelevant at this level.

**Logistics**
-------------

* Experience: 1\-2 years of marketing at a startup or agency.
* Location: Full\-time, in\-office, Ahmedabad.
* Reports to: Piyush, Co\-founder.
* Compensation: Based on your experience and portfolio. We'll be straight about ranges on the first call.
* Bonus: A personal blog or newsletter, an active X profile (any size), B2B SaaS exposure, or light video skills.
